messages:
ava: Quick thought: canary flips caused noisy local rollbacks yesterday. Propose an edge-first fallback that is tenant-scoped, cheap, and auditable. Keen on EWMA smoothing + short lease to avoid split-brain.

kevin: Sounds right. Sketch: compute EWMA(probe_error) and EWMA(p99) on a 30s tick, combine into score; if score>threshold set local_override for tenant with TTL=30s. Require 3 healthy ticks to recover.

sam: Additions: backoff ladder [30,60,120]s before re-eval, and operator_force_key that central control-plane can set for urgent global rollbacks. Edge must push stamped telemetry event when override occurs.

ava: Example policy blob (inline):
```json
{"schema":"edge-fb-v1","apply_scope":"tenant","ewma_alpha":0.2,"threshold":0.06,"ttl_s":30,"recover_ticks":3,"backoff_s":[30,60,120],"force_key":"console.override.v1"}
```

kevin: Observability: emit metric edge_override_count{reason,tenant,instance} and set trace header x-edge-fallback: inst=...,reason=...,policy_rev=... when fallback applied. Decision path must run on timer, not per-request.

sam: Ownership: infra owns generic probes and EWMA infra; runtime owns feature detectors (hallucination, etc.) which can be weighted into the score. Keep schema compatible with Dedicated by allowing control-plane-sourced policy.

deploy-bot: [deploy-check] policy schema v1 validated. 0 warnings.

ava: Action items: kevin to prototype evaluator + TTL/backoff (PR). infra to publish EWMA lib + probe ownership doc. sam to add force-key integration. We'll iterate thresholds in canary runs. :white_check_mark:
